basic_info.description: Ideally located on the border of Bernal, Noe Valley & the Mission, this sunny, renovated condo w/new oak wood floors will charm you! Enjoy 2 spacious bedrooms w/new carpeting & large closets and 1 updated bathroom w/jetted soaking tub! The property boasts a wonderful floor plan w/nice separation between the bedrooms and the living space. The spacious, open kitchen/dining room/living room is a fabulous space for entertaining and features a breakfast bar, all brand-new s/s appliances, ample cabinets, granite counters & recessed lighting. This lovely home also enjoys a brand-new in-unit washer/dryer, 1-car garage parking for a large vehicle & shared bike storage. Enjoy the peaceful shared courtyard w/multiple seating areas surrounded by greenery/fruit trees - perfect for relaxing. Elevator building! 199 Tiffany is conveniently situated in a very bike-able & walkable location, boasting a 97 Walk Score! Cafe Seventy8 on the corner & multiple other cafes nearby; Safeway is up the street; Mitchell's ice cream, Four Chairs, Front Porch, Blue Plate & other popular Bernal, Mission & Noe Valley restaurants are within a few blocks! The upper Noe Valley RecCenter/playground is 5 blocks away. Stroll w/your dog up to Bernal Heights Park. Walk to Muni, Bart & tech shuttles. Easy freeway access.
